Clean twin of claude-external-headless: the same files, with Project instructions set to claude-md-and-agents-md in ~/.claude/settings.json. Claude Code then reads the root AGENTS.md as an AGENTS.md above the launch directory, not through the import, so launched in packages/api every file arrives without an approval. ctxreach must report nothing.

Scope: the expected report above is for the test suite's run of this fixture. The census check K1 (study/census/known-answer.mjs) serves only repo/, with empty homes, and launches from the root and every type-2 and type-3 directory for both agents. There, the default mode applies and, from packages/api, the root import stays external with no approval: map raises claude.external-import-headless, O2 is an event, and Codex warns codex.nested at the root. study/census/known-answers.json holds the census answer.
